text:
marco: Quick sync — LaunchOrbit (cloud marketplace) wants coordinated go-live tomorrow. Press embargo at 14:00 PT, partner wants hero + badge + SI link live at same time.

leah: Ops noted a maintenance slot at 14:05 PT on staging-4. Could cause CDN purge hiccups if we purge immediately.

carlos: Recommend pre-stage assets behind feature-flag and flip at embargo lift. That avoids deploy contention.

rita: Marketing insists on exact UTM & promo code for press. Also legal needs the short partner credit line included in meta.

opsbot: Feature-flag schedule available. Ops needs S3 path and tracking strings for preview.

partner-upload-bot: Assets uploaded to s3://marketplace/launchorbit/hero-final at 09:18 PT. Sitemap + badge included.

marco: Proposed timeline: assets by 10:30 PT, ops preview 11:30 PT, legal signoff 13:00 PT, embargo flip 14:00 PT, CDN purge 14:12 PT (after maintenance), SI smoke 14:05 PT.

leah: Ops will run a dry-run flip at 13:50 PT (internal only) and will be in #release-war-room for live flip. We'll avoid the purge during the 14:05 maintenance window and run at 14:12 PT instead.

carlos: SI checklist: whitelist partner egress IPs, verify OAuth token exchange. After flip run: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://si.launchorbit.com/health | jq .status` expecting "ok".

rita: Partner provided UTM strings: utm_source=launchorbit&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=launch_q2 and promo=LAUNCH10. Legal crediting: "Partner content provided by LaunchOrbit." I'll paste exact copy at 13:00 PT.

marco: Owners: assets=partner-upload-bot, ops=leah, press=rita, SI=carlos. Preview agenda 11:30 PT: visual QA, flag preview, smoke-test dry run, legal copy in meta.

partner-upload-bot: Preview link: https://staging-4.redwood.ai/launchorbit/preview (assets uploaded 09:18 PT).

leah: Preview looks OK but partner logo needs a minor padding tweak on mobile. Pinged partner to reupload; will accept small patch up to 11:00 PT.

marco: If patch misses 11:00 PT we proceed with current asset and note in postmortem. Fallback plan: delay hero flip to 14:30 PT if SI or asset problems.

opsbot: Reminders set: preview @ 11:30 PT, dry-run @ 13:50 PT, flip @ 14:00 PT. Post-launch checks at +5m and +15m.

rita: I'll hold press channel and will not call publish until legal copy is confirmed in meta.

carlos: Will run SI smoke test at +5m. If token exchange fails we'll rollback feature flag within 3 minutes.

marco: Thanks team. Keep updates brief in this thread — only call immediate blockers in #release-war-room. :rocket:
